title: Commit Conventions & Release Categories (SSOT)
description: Single Source of Truth for Conventional Commit types, category emojis, and release note mappings in ytm-web-controller.

body_template: - <bullet point explaining why the change was made>

feat.description: New Stream Deck actions, dials, WebSocket features, or UI settings.

fix.description: Resolved DOM extraction issues, reconnection fixes, or UI bugs.

perf.description: Hardware 10-Hz rate-limit compliance, canvas caching, memory leak fixes.

refactor.description: Structural cleanups without behavior or API changes.

docs.description: Updates to docs/, README.md, or architecture diagrams.

style.description: Code formatting, comment alignment, whitespace adjustments.

test.description: Test suites, validation scenarios, and mock fixtures.

chore.description: Dependency updates, packaging scripts, and GitHub Actions pipelines.

breaking.description: Incompatible API, handshake protocol, or hardware changes.
